## 1. Definition of the working environment
```{r section_1_definition_of_the_working_environment}
repo_base <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luismiguelsoto/Centralization_and_integration_in_Tairona_chiefdoms_of_the_Rio_Frio_basin/main/GIS"

folder <- file.path(tempdir(), "JARE_GIS_DATA")
if (!dir.exists(folder)) dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE)

gis_files <- c(
"DEM_POLYGON_52KM.tif",
  "LOCAL_COMMUNITIES.cpg", "LOCAL_COMMUNITIES.dbf", "LOCAL_COMMUNITIES.prj",
  "LOCAL_COMMUNITIES.qmd", "LOCAL_COMMUNITIES.shp", "LOCAL_COMMUNITIES.shx",
  "regression_data.rds",
  "POLYGON_SURVEY_RIO_FRIO.cpg", "POLYGON_SURVEY_RIO_FRIO.dbf", "POLYGON_SURVEY_RIO_FRIO.prj",
  "POLYGON_SURVEY_RIO_FRIO.qmd", "POLYGON_SURVEY_RIO_FRIO.shp", "POLYGON_SURVEY_RIO_FRIO.shx",
  "RIVER_POLYGON_52KM.cpg", "RIVER_POLYGON_52KM.dbf", "RIVER_POLYGON_52KM.prj",
  "RIVER_POLYGON_52KM.qmd", "RIVER_POLYGON_52KM.shp", "RIVER_POLYGON_52KM.shx",
  "SOILS_AGRICULTURE_RASTER_52KM.tif", "TAIRONA_CERAMICS.rds",
  "TAIRONA_POLYGONS_SITES.cpg", "TAIRONA_POLYGONS_SITES.dbf", "TAIRONA_POLYGONS_SITES.prj",
  "TAIRONA_POLYGONS_SITES.qmd", "TAIRONA_POLYGONS_SITES.shp", "TAIRONA_POLYGONS_SITES.shx",
  "TAIRONA_STRUCTURES.cpg", "TAIRONA_STRUCTURES.dbf", "TAIRONA_STRUCTURES.prj",
  "TAIRONA_STRUCTURES.qmd", "TAIRONA_STRUCTURES.shp", "TAIRONA_STRUCTURES.shx"
)

cat("Downloading GIS files from GitHub repository...\n")
for (f in gis_files) {
  dest_path <- file.path(folder, f)
  if (!file.exists(dest_path)) {
    url <- paste0(repo_base, "/", f)
    tryCatch(download.file(url, destfile = dest_path, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE),
             error = function(e) warning(paste("Could not download:", f, "-", e$message)))
  }
}
cat("Downloaded", length(list.files(folder)), "of", length(gis_files), "files.\n")

stopifnot(dir.exists(folder))
options(digits = 6, scipen = 50)
set.seed(123)

packages <- c("sf","lwgeom","terra","car","spatstat.geom","spatstat.random",
  "ggplot2","ggspatial","patchwork","dplyr","viridis","scales",
  "raster","sp","movecost","igraph","knitr","dunn.test",
  "readxl","mgcv","gratia","tidyr","tibble","RColorBrewer",
  "MASS","mice","sandwich","lmtest","betareg")
to_install <- setdiff(packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install, dependencies = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(packages, function(p) suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(p, character.only = TRUE))))

shps <- list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.shp$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
tifs <- list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.(tif|tiff)$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
if (length(shps) == 0) stop("No .shp files found.")
if (length(tifs) == 0) warning("No .tif/.tiff files found.")

pick_file <- function(patterns, files_vec) {
  for (pt in patterns) { hit <- grep(pt, files_vec, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE); if (length(hit) >= 1) return(hit[1]) }
  NA_character_
}

shp_survey     <- pick_file(c("POLYGON_SURVEY_RIO_FRIO\\.shp$"), shps)
shp_structures <- pick_file(c("TAIRONA_STRUCTURES\\.shp$"), shps)
shp_sites_poly <- pick_file(c("TAIRONA_POLYGONS_SITES\\.shp$"), shps)
shp_localcom   <- pick_file(c("LOCAL_COMMUNITIES\\.shp$"), shps)
tif_soils      <- pick_file(c("SOILS_AGRICULTURE_RASTER_52KM\\.(tif|tiff)$"), tifs)
shp_river      <- pick_file(c("RIVER_POLYGON_52KM\\.shp$"), shps)

stopifnot(!is.na(shp_survey), file.exists(shp_survey))
stopifnot(!is.na(shp_structures), file.exists(shp_structures))
stopifnot(!is.na(shp_sites_poly), file.exists(shp_sites_poly))
stopifnot(!is.na(tif_soils), file.exists(tif_soils))

target_crs <- 32618
```

## 2. Nearest neighbor analysis
```{r section_2_nearest_neighbor_analysis}
survey_sf <- sf::st_read(shp_survey, quiet = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_transform(target_crs) |>
  sf::st_zm(drop = TRUE, what = "ZM") |>
  sf::st_make_valid()

survey_union <- survey_sf |>
  sf::st_union() |>
  sf::st_make_valid() |>
  sf::st_collection_extract("POLYGON")

survey_union_sf <- sf::st_sf(geometry = survey_union)
survey_v <- terra::vect(survey_union_sf)

struc_sf <- sf::st_read(shp_structures, quiet = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_transform(target_crs)

struc_sf_xy <- sf::st_zm(struc_sf, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM")

inside <- sf::st_within(struc_sf_xy, survey_union, sparse = FALSE)[, 1]
struc_sf_xy <- struc_sf_xy[inside, , drop = FALSE]

coords <- sf::st_coordinates(struc_sf_xy)
Tairona_data <- data.frame(UTM_East = coords[, 1], UTM_North = coords[, 2])

x_col <- "UTM_East"
y_col <- "UTM_North"

n <- nrow(Tairona_data)
stopifnot(n > 1)

A_m2  <- as.numeric(sf::st_area(survey_union))
A_km2 <- A_m2 / 1e6

sites_poly_sf <- sf::st_read(shp_sites_poly, quiet = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_transform(target_crs) |>
  sf::st_make_valid()

local_comm_sf <- NULL
if (!is.na(shp_localcom) && file.exists(shp_localcom)) {
  local_comm_sf <- sf::st_read(shp_localcom, quiet = TRUE) |>
    sf::st_transform(target_crs)
}

soils_r <- terra::rast(tif_soils)

if (!is.na(terra::crs(soils_r)) && terra::crs(soils_r) != sf::st_crs(target_crs)$wkt) {
  soils_r <- terra::project(soils_r, sf::st_crs(target_crs)$wkt, method = "near")
}

soils_r <- terra::crop(soils_r, survey_v)
soils_r <- terra::mask(soils_r, survey_v)

names(soils_r) <- "SOILS_CLASS"

sf_to_owin_manual <- function(poly_sf) {
  g <- sf::st_geometry(poly_sf)
  g <- g[!sf::st_is_empty(g)]
  g <- sf::st_cast(g, "MULTIPOLYGON", warn = FALSE)

  cc <- sf::st_coordinates(g)
  cc <- as.data.frame(cc)
  needed <- c("X", "Y", "L1", "L2", "L3")
  stopifnot(all(needed %in% names(cc)))

  mk_ring <- function(df) list(x = df$X, y = df$Y)

  ow_list <- list()
  idx <- 0

  feats <- unique(cc$L1)
  for (f in feats) {
    cc_f <- cc[cc$L1 == f, , drop = FALSE]
    polys <- unique(cc_f$L2)

    for (p in polys) {
      cc_p <- cc_f[cc_f$L2 == p, , drop = FALSE]
      rings <- sort(unique(cc_p$L3))

      outer_df <- cc_p[cc_p$L3 == rings[1], , drop = FALSE]
      outer <- mk_ring(outer_df)

      holes <- NULL
      if (length(rings) > 1) {
        holes <- lapply(rings[-1], function(rg) mk_ring(cc_p[cc_p$L3 == rg, , drop = FALSE]))
      }

      idx <- idx + 1
      ow_list[[idx]] <- if (is.null(holes)) {
        spatstat.geom::owin(poly = outer)
      } else {
        spatstat.geom::owin(poly = outer, hole = holes)
      }
    }
  }

  W <- ow_list[[1]]
  if (length(ow_list) > 1) {
    for (k in 2:length(ow_list)) W <- spatstat.geom::union.owin(W, ow_list[[k]])
  }
  W
}

W <- tryCatch(
  spatstat.geom::as.owin(sf::st_geometry(survey_union_sf)),
  error = function(e) sf_to_owin_manual(survey_union_sf)
)

pp <- spatstat.geom::ppp(
  x      = Tairona_data[[x_col]],
  y      = Tairona_data[[y_col]],
  window = W
)

if (any(duplicated(spatstat.geom::coords(pp)))) {
  pp <- spatstat.random::rjitter(pp, radius = 0.001)
}

NND  <- spatstat.geom::nndist(pp)
MNND <- mean(NND)
SDND <- sd(NND)

lambda  <- n / A_m2
EXPNND  <- 0.5 / sqrt(lambda)
R_index <- MNND / EXPNND

SE_mnnd         <- (0.26136 * sqrt(A_m2)) / n
z_ce            <- (MNND - EXPNND) / SE_mnnd
p_ce_two_sided  <- 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(z_ce))

nsim <- 999
mnnd_sim <- replicate(nsim, {
  sim_pp <- spatstat.random::runifpoint(n, win = W)
  mean(spatstat.geom::nndist(sim_pp))
})

p_lower        <- (1 + sum(mnnd_sim <= MNND)) / (nsim + 1)
p_upper        <- (1 + sum(mnnd_sim >= MNND)) / (nsim + 1)
p_mc_two_sided <- min(1, 2 * min(p_lower, p_upper))

ce_test <- spatstat.explore::clarkevans.test(pp, correction = "cdf", nsim = 999)

get_first_numeric <- function(obj) {
  if (is.null(obj) || length(obj) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(obj[1]))
}

CE_p <- get_first_numeric(ce_test$p.value)
if (is.na(CE_p)) CE_p <- get_first_numeric(ce_test$p)

CE_R <- get_first_numeric(ce_test$R)
if (is.na(CE_R)) {
  CE_R <- get_first_numeric(ce_test$statistic[names(ce_test$statistic) %in% c("R", "r", "R (Clark-Evans)")])
}

NN_report <- data.frame(
  N_points         = n,
  Area_m2          = round(A_m2, 2),
  Area_km2         = round(A_km2, 5),
  Intensity_lambda = signif(lambda, 6),
  MNND_observed_m  = round(MNND, 3),
  SD_NND_m         = round(SDND, 3),
  MNND_expected_m  = round(EXPNND, 3),
  R_index          = round(R_index, 4),
  SE_MNND_m        = round(SE_mnnd, 4),
  z_approx         = round(z_ce, 3),
  p_approx_2s      = signif(p_ce_two_sided, 4),
  p_MC_CSR_2s      = signif(p_mc_two_sided, 4),
  nsim_MC          = nsim,
  CE_R             = round(CE_R, 4),
  CE_p_value       = signif(CE_p, 4)
)

conf_levels <- c(0.80, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99)
tcrit <- sapply(conf_levels, function(cl) stats::qt(1 - (1 - cl) / 2, df = n - 1))

ME      <- tcrit * (SDND / sqrt(n))
CI_low  <- MNND - ME
CI_high <- MNND + ME

CI_table <- data.frame(
  Confidence = paste0(conf_levels * 100, "%"),
  Mean_MNND  = round(MNND, 3),
  Margin     = round(ME, 3),
  CI_Lower   = round(CI_low, 3),
  CI_Upper   = round(CI_high, 3)
)

nn_summary_tbl <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Number of terraces",
    "Survey area (km2)",
    "Observed mean NND (m)",
    "Expected mean NND (m)",
    "Simple R index",
    "Clark-Evans R (CDF corrected)",
    "Clark-Evans p-value"
  ),
  Value = c(
    format(n, big.mark = ","),
    sprintf("%.4f", A_km2),
    sprintf("%.3f", MNND),
    sprintf("%.3f", EXPNND),
    sprintf("%.4f", R_index),
    sprintf("%.4f", CE_R),
    ifelse(CE_p < 0.001, "< 0.001", format(signif(CE_p, 4), scientific = FALSE))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(nn_summary_tbl, caption = "Nearest-neighbor analysis: manuscript-statistics summary")

nx_hi <- 2000
ny_hi <- 2000
SIGMA_MULT <- 9.5

bw_default <- spatstat.explore::bw.diggle(pp)
sigma_use  <- as.numeric(bw_default) * SIGMA_MULT

dens_im <- spatstat.explore::density.ppp(
  pp, sigma = sigma_use, edge = TRUE, at = "pixels", dimyx = c(ny_hi, nx_hi)
)

dens_df <- as.data.frame(dens_im)
names(dens_df) <- c("x", "y", "z")

p_kde <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = survey_union_sf, fill = "grey85", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_raster(data = dens_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = z)) +
  geom_point(
    data = Tairona_data,
    aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = .data[[y_col]]),
    size = 0.18, alpha = 0.55
  ) +
  viridis::scale_fill_viridis(option = "plasma", direction = 1, name = "Density") +
  coord_sf(crs = sf::st_crs(target_crs), datum = NA) +

  ) +
  labs(

    subtitle = paste0(
      "bw.diggle = ", round(as.numeric(bw_default), 2),
      " m | sigma = bw * ", SIGMA_MULT,
      " = ", round(sigma_use, 2),
      " m | Resolution = ", nx_hi, "×", ny_hi
    ),
    x = "East (m)", y = "North (m)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +

df_nnd <- data.frame(NND = NND)

ci_text <- paste0(
  paste0(CI_table$Confidence, ": ", CI_table$Mean_MNND, " \u00B1 ", CI_table$Margin),
  collapse = "\n"
)

p_hist <- ggplot(df_nnd, aes(x = NND)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "black", color = "black") +
```

## 3. Ripley's K
```{r section_3_ripleys_k}
fmt_time <- function(sec) {
  if (is.na(sec)) return("NA")
  if (sec < 60) return(paste0(round(sec, 1), " s"))
  if (sec < 3600) return(paste0(round(sec/60, 1), " min"))
  paste0(round(sec/3600, 2), " h")
}

t0 <- proc.time()
L <- spatstat.explore::Lest(pp, correction = c("iso","trans","border"))
tL <- (proc.time() - t0)[["elapsed"]]
cat("Ripley Lest():", fmt_time(tL), "\n")

t0 <- proc.time()
g <- spatstat.explore::pcf(pp, correction = c("iso","trans"))
tg <- (proc.time() - t0)[["elapsed"]]
cat("Pair correlation pcf():", fmt_time(tg), "\n")

nsim_final <- 99
nsim_pilot <- 9

t0 <- proc.time()
envK_pilot <- spatstat.explore::envelope(
  pp, fun = spatstat.explore::Kest,
  nsim = nsim_pilot, correction = "best",
  global = FALSE, verbose = FALSE
)
tp <- (proc.time() - t0)[["elapsed"]]
est_total <- tp * (nsim_final / nsim_pilot)

cat("K-envelope pilot (", nsim_pilot, " sims): ", fmt_time(tp),
    " | Estimated for ", nsim_final, " sims: ", fmt_time(est_total), "\n", sep = "")

t0 <- proc.time()
envK <- spatstat.explore::envelope(
  pp, fun = spatstat.explore::Kest,
  nsim = nsim_final, correction = "best",
  global = FALSE, verbose = FALSE
)
tK <- (proc.time() - t0)[["elapsed"]]
cat("K-envelope final (", nsim_final, " sims): ", fmt_time(tK), "\n", sep = "")

L_df <- as.data.frame(L)
g_df <- as.data.frame(g)
E_df <- as.data.frame(envK)

pick_col <- function(df, x) {
  h <- intersect(x, names(df))
  if (length(h)) h[1] else NA_character_
}

colL <- pick_col(L_df, c("iso","trans","border","km"))
stopifnot(!is.na(colL))
L_df$L_minus_r <- L_df[[colL]] - L_df$r

col_obs <- pick_col(E_df, c("obs","iso","trans","border"))
col_lo  <- pick_col(E_df, c("lo","low","loiso","lo.trans"))
col_hi  <- pick_col(E_df, c("hi","high","hiiso","hi.trans"))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(c(col_obs, col_lo, col_hi))))

E_df$obs <- E_df[[col_obs]]
E_df$lo  <- E_df[[col_lo]]
E_df$hi  <- E_df[[col_hi]]

E_df$pattern <- dplyr::case_when(
  E_df$obs > E_df$hi ~ "Clustered",
  E_df$obs < E_df$lo ~ "Regular / Dispersed",
  TRUE              ~ "Not significant"
)

iL <- which.max(L_df$L_minus_r)
ig <- which.max(g_df$iso)

ripley_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Number of points",
    "CSR simulations",
    "Maximum L(r) − r (m)",
    "Distance at max L(r) − r (m)",
    "Maximum g(r)",
    "Distance at max g(r) (m)",
    "Percent of distances clustered",
    "Percent of distances dispersed"
  ),
  Value = c(
    spatstat.geom::npoints(pp),
    nsim_final,
    round(L_df$L_minus_r[iL], 2),
    round(L_df$r[iL], 0),
    round(g_df$iso[ig], 2),
    round(g_df$r[ig], 0),
    round(mean(E_df$pattern == "Clustered") * 100, 1),
    round(mean(E_df$pattern == "Regular / Dispersed") * 100, 1)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

scale_table <- E_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(grp = cumsum(pattern != dplyr::lag(pattern, default = first(pattern)))) |>
  dplyr::group_by(pattern, grp) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    r_min = min(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    r_max = max(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    span  = r_max - r_min,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(pattern != "Not significant") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Distance_range_m = paste0(round(r_min, 0), "–", round(r_max, 0)),
    Scale_width_m    = round(span, 0)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Spatial_pattern = pattern,
    Distance_range_m,
    Scale_width_m
  )

if (nrow(scale_table) == 0) {
  scale_table <- data.frame(
    Spatial_pattern = "Not significant",
    Distance_range_m = NA_character_,
    Scale_width_m = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

knitr::kable(ripley_summary, caption = "Ripley's K: manuscript-statistics summary")
knitr::kable(scale_table, caption = "Ripley's K: significant distance range")

oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(3, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 2.2, 1), las = 1)

plot(L, . - r ~ r, main = "A. Ripley’s L(r) − r", legendargs = list(cex = 0.8, xpd = NA))
abline(h = 0, lty = 3)

plot(g, main = "B. Pair correlation function g(r)", legendargs = list(cex = 0.8, xpd = NA))
abline(h = 1, lty = 3)

plot(envK,
     main = paste0("C. K-function envelope (CSR, ", nsim_final, " simulations)"),
     legendargs = list(cex = 0.8, xpd = NA))

par(oldpar)
```

## 4. Evaluation of settlement hierarchies (Rank-Size / A coefficient)
```{r section_4_rank_size_a_coefficient}
compute_A_coefficient <- function(sizes_vec){
  s <- sort(sizes_vec, decreasing = TRUE)
  n <- length(s)
  
  if(n < 2) return(c(A = NA_real_, A1 = NA_real_, A2 = NA_real_))
  
  r <- seq_len(n)
  x     <- log(r) / log(n)
  y_ref <- 1 - x
  y_obs <- (log(s) - log(max(s)) + log(n)) / log(n)
  
  d  <- y_obs - y_ref
  dx <- diff(x)
  
  A  <- sum((head(d, -1) + tail(d, -1)) / 2 * dx)
  A1 <- sum((pmax(head(d, -1), 0) + pmax(tail(d, -1), 0)) / 2 * dx)
  A2 <- sum((pmin(head(d, -1), 0) + pmin(tail(d, -1), 0)) / 2 * dx)
  
  c(A = A, A1 = A1, A2 = A2)
}

calculate_A_rsboot <- function(sizes, confidence_levels = 90, R = 10000, seed = 1){
  set.seed(seed)
  
  s <- sort(sizes, decreasing = TRUE)
  n <- length(s)
  
  A_obs <- as.numeric(compute_A_coefficient(s)["A"])
  
  A_boot <- replicate(R, {
    ss <- sort(sample(s, n, replace = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE)
    as.numeric(compute_A_coefficient(ss)["A"])
  })
  
  A_boot_c <- as.numeric(A_boot + (A_obs - mean(A_boot)))
  
  ci_matrix <- sapply(confidence_levels, function(cl){
    if (cl <= 1) cl <- cl * 100
    alpha <- 1 - cl / 100
    stats::quantile(A_boot_c, probs = c(alpha/2, 1 - alpha/2), names = FALSE, type = 7)
  })
  
  if (is.null(dim(ci_matrix))) ci_matrix <- matrix(ci_matrix, nrow = 2)
  rownames(ci_matrix) <- c("Lower", "Upper")
  
  list(A = A_obs, ci = ci_matrix, A_boot_c = A_boot_c)
}

zone_curves_rsboot <- function(sizes, confidence_level = 90, R = 12000, seed = 1){
  set.seed(seed)
  
  s <- sort(sizes, decreasing = TRUE)
  n <- length(s)
  r <- seq_len(n)
  smax <- max(s)
  
  boot_samps <- replicate(R, sort(sample(s, n, replace = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE))
  keep <- apply(boot_samps, 2, function(col) max(col) == smax)
  boot_samps <- boot_samps[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  
  A_obs <- as.numeric(compute_A_coefficient(s)["A"])
  A_bs  <- apply(boot_samps, 2, function(col) as.numeric(compute_A_coefficient(col)["A"]))
  A_bs  <- as.numeric(A_bs + (A_obs - mean(A_bs)))
  
  cl <- confidence_level
  if (cl <= 1) cl <- cl * 100
  alpha <- 1 - cl / 100
  
  q_lo <- stats::quantile(A_bs, probs = alpha/2,     names = FALSE, type = 7)
  q_hi <- stats::quantile(A_bs, probs = 1 - alpha/2, names = FALSE, type = 7)
  
  idx_lo <- which.min(abs(A_bs - q_lo))
  idx_hi <- which.min(abs(A_bs - q_hi))
  
  list(
    ranks       = r,
    lower_curve = boot_samps[, idx_lo],
    upper_curve = boot_samps[, idx_hi]
  )
}

plot_rank_size <- function(sizes, confidence_level = 90,
                           R_zone = 12000, seed = 1,
                           A_val = NULL, A_ci = NULL){
  sizes_sorted <- sort(sizes, decreasing = TRUE)
  ranks        <- seq_along(sizes_sorted)
  lognorm      <- max(sizes_sorted) * ranks^-1
  
  zone <- zone_curves_rsboot(sizes_sorted, confidence_level, R = R_zone, seed = seed)
  
  df <- data.frame(
    Rank      = ranks,
    Observed  = sizes_sorted,
    LogNormal = lognorm,
    UpperCI   = zone$upper_curve,
    LowerCI   = zone$lower_curve
  )
  
  title_str <- paste0(
    "Rank–Size Plot (", confidence_level, "% CI, RSBOOT-style)",
    if (!is.null(A_val) && !is.null(A_ci)) {
      sprintf("\nA = %.3f  (%d%% CI: %.3f to %.3f)", A_val, confidence_level, A_ci[1], A_ci[2])
    } else ""
  )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Rank)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LowerCI, ymax = UpperCI), fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Observed,  color = "Observed"),   linewidth = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(y = LogNormal, color = "Log-Normal"), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(title = title_str, x = "Rank", y = "Settlement size (ha)", color = "Legend") +
    theme_bw()
}
```

## 5. Evaluation of demographic centralization (B values)
```{r section_5_demographic_centralization_b_values}
n_rings  <- 12
dist_max <- 5992.292
center_x <- 599413
center_y <- 1212647

area_total    <- A_m2
area_per_ring <- area_total / n_rings
cum_areas     <- cumsum(rep(area_per_ring, n_rings))
radii         <- sqrt(cum_areas / pi)
scale_factor  <- dist_max / max(radii)
radii_scaled  <- radii * scale_factor

center_pt <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_point(c(center_x, center_y)), crs = sf::st_crs(survey_union))

rings_list <- vector("list", n_rings)
for (i in seq_len(n_rings)) {
  outer <- sf::st_buffer(center_pt, dist = radii_scaled[i])
  if (i == 1) {
    ring <- outer
  } else {
    inner <- sf::st_buffer(center_pt, dist = radii_scaled[i - 1])
    ring  <- sf::st_difference(outer, inner)
  }
  rings_list[[i]] <- sf::st_intersection(ring, survey_union)
}

valid_rings <- Filter(function(x) !sf::st_is_empty(x), rings_list)

rings_sf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(valid_rings), function(i) {
  sf::st_sf(geometry = valid_rings[[i]], ring = i)
})) |>
  sf::st_make_valid()

counts <- sapply(valid_rings, function(r) {
  sum(sf::st_within(struc_sf_xy, r, sparse = FALSE))
})
rings_sf$count <- as.integer(counts)

table_rings <- data.frame(
  Ring                 = rings_sf$ring,
  Radius_m             = radii_scaled[seq_len(nrow(rings_sf))],
  Estimated_Structures = rings_sf$count
)

total_structures <- sum(table_rings$Estimated_Structures)

table_rings$Proportion_exact      <- table_rings$Estimated_Structures / total_structures
table_rings$Cumulative_exact      <- cumsum(table_rings$Proportion_exact)
table_rings$Proportion            <- round(table_rings$Proportion_exact * 100, 1)
table_rings$Cumulative_Proportion <- round(table_rings$Cumulative_exact * 100, 1)

calc_CI_90 <- function(p, n) {
  if (n == 0) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  se <- sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / n)
  z  <- 1.645
  lower <- max(0, p - z * se)
  upper <- min(1, p + z * se)
  c(lower, upper)
}

table_rings$CI_Lower_90 <- NA_real_
table_rings$CI_Upper_90 <- NA_real_

for (i in seq_len(nrow(table_rings))) {
  p_i <- table_rings$Proportion_exact[i]
  n_i <- table_rings$Estimated_Structures[i]
  if (n_i > 0) {
    ic <- calc_CI_90(p_i, n_i)
    table_rings$CI_Lower_90[i] <- ic[1] * 100
    table_rings$CI_Upper_90[i] <- ic[2] * 100
  }
}

w <- rev(seq_len(nrow(table_rings)))
B <- (100 * sum(w * table_rings$Proportion_exact) - 650) / 550

wp     <- sum(w * table_rings$Proportion_exact)
var_wp <- (sum((w^2) * table_rings$Proportion_exact) - wp^2) / total_structures
se_B   <- (100 / 550) * sqrt(var_wp)
z95    <- 1.96

B_margin95 <- z95 * se_B
B_low95    <- B - B_margin95
B_high95   <- B + B_margin95

table_output <- data.frame(
  Ring                      = table_rings$Ring,
  Estimated_Structures      = table_rings$Estimated_Structures,
  Structure_Proportion_pct  = paste0(table_rings$Proportion, "%"),
  Cumulative_Proportion_pct = paste0(table_rings$Cumulative_Proportion, "%")
)

table_output <- rbind(
  table_output,
  data.frame(
    Ring = "Total",
    Estimated_Structures = total_structures,
    Structure_Proportion_pct = "100%",
    Cumulative_Proportion_pct = paste0(sum(table_rings$Cumulative_Proportion), "%")
  ),
  data.frame(
    Ring = "B value (95% CI)",
    Estimated_Structures = NA,
    Structure_Proportion_pct = paste0(sprintf("%.4f", B), " ± ", sprintf("%.4f", B_margin95)),
    Cumulative_Proportion_pct = sprintf("[%.4f, %.4f]", B_low95, B_high95)
  )
)


final_table <- table_rings
final_table$CI_Lower_90 <- ifelse(is.na(final_table$CI_Lower_90), final_table$Proportion, final_table$CI_Lower_90)
final_table$CI_Upper_90 <- ifelse(is.na(final_table$CI_Upper_90), final_table$Proportion, final_table$CI_Upper_90)

soil_labels <- c(
  "1. Very Low", "2. Low", "3. Medium-Low",

cls_levels <- sort(unique(terra::values(soils_r, na.rm = TRUE)))

names(soil_colors) <- as.character(seq_along(soil_colors))

cols_map   <- setNames(soil_colors[seq_len(length(cls_levels))], as.character(cls_levels))

tab_test <- tab_ring_class
```

## 6. Least-cost paths and space syntax
```{r section_6_least_cost_paths_and_space_syntax}
dem_tif <- pick_file(
  c(
    "DEM_POLYGON_52KM\\.(tif|tiff)$",
    "DEM.*52KM.*\\.(tif|tiff)$",
    "DEM.*\\.(tif|tiff)$"
  ),
  tifs
)

stopifnot(!is.na(dem_tif), file.exists(dem_tif))
stopifnot(!is.na(shp_localcom), file.exists(shp_localcom))

centroids_path <- shp_localcom
dem_path       <- dem_tif

crs_utm18n <- sf::st_crs(target_crs)

dem_raster <- raster::raster(dem_path)

if (is.na(raster::crs(dem_raster))) {
  raster::crs(dem_raster) <- crs_utm18n$wkt
} else {
  if (!raster::compareCRS(dem_raster, crs_utm18n$wkt)) {
    dem_raster <- raster::projectRaster(dem_raster, crs = crs_utm18n$wkt, method = "bilinear")
  }
}

centroids <- sf::st_read(centroids_path, quiet = TRUE)

if (is.na(sf::st_crs(centroids))) sf::st_crs(centroids) <- crs_utm18n
if (!all(sf::st_geometry_type(centroids) == "POINT")) centroids <- sf::st_cast(centroids, "POINT")

centroids <- sf::st_transform(centroids, crs = crs_utm18n)
centroids <- sf::st_zm(centroids, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM")

centroids <- centroids[sf::st_within(centroids, survey_union, sparse = FALSE)[, 1], , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(centroids) >= 2)

coords_full <- sf::st_coordinates(centroids)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]

coords_sp      <- sp::SpatialPoints(coords_full, proj4string = sp::CRS(raster::projection(dem_raster)))
origins_sp_net <- coords_sp

dest_spdf_all <- sp::SpatialPointsDataFrame(
  coords      = coords_sp,
  data        = data.frame(id = seq_len(nrow(coords_full))),
  proj4string = sp::CRS(raster::projection(dem_raster))
)

# 1. Isocronas acumuladas de todas las comunidades (Todos contra Todos)
result3 <- movecost::movecost(
  dtm           = dem_raster,
  origin        = dest_spdf_all,
  move          = 16,
  funct         = "t",
  time          = "m",
  breaks        = 40,
  N             = 2,
  irregular.dtm = TRUE,
  oneplot       = TRUE
)
print(result3)

# 2. Redes de rutas (allpairs)
result4 <- movecost::movenetw(
  dtm           = dem_raster,
  origin        = origins_sp_net,
  funct         = "t",
  netw.type     = "allpairs",
  irregular.dtm = TRUE
)
print(result4)

# 3. Redes de rutas (neigh)
result5 <- movecost::movenetw(
  dtm           = dem_raster,
  origin        = origins_sp_net,
  funct         = "t",
  netw.type     = "neigh",
  irregular.dtm = TRUE
)
print(result5)

# 4. Sintaxis Espacial
stopifnot(exists("sites_poly_sf"), inherits(sites_poly_sf, "sf"))
stopifnot(exists("survey_union"), inherits(survey_union, "sfc") || inherits(survey_union, "sf"))

sites_sf      <- sf::st_transform(sites_poly_sf, sf::st_crs(target_crs)) |> sf::st_make_valid()
study_area_sf <- sf::st_transform(survey_union,  sf::st_crs(target_crs)) |> sf::st_make_valid()

sites_centroids <- sf::st_centroid(sites_sf)

id_field_sites <- if ("ID" %in% names(sites_sf)) {
  "ID"
} else if ("id" %in% names(sites_sf)) {
  "id"
} else {
  sites_sf$ID <- seq_len(nrow(sites_sf))
  "ID"
}
sites_sf[[id_field_sites]] <- as.character(sites_sf[[id_field_sites]])

sites_sp <- methods::as(sites_centroids, "Spatial")
row.names(sites_sp) <- sites_sf[[id_field_sites]]

site_network <- movecost::movenetw(
  dtm           = dem_raster,
  origin        = sites_sp,
  funct         = "t",
  netw.type     = "allpairs",
  irregular.dtm = TRUE
)

cost_matrix <- site_network$cost.matrix.min
diag(cost_matrix) <- 0
cost_matrix <- pmin(cost_matrix, t(cost_matrix), na.rm = TRUE)
cost_matrix[!is.finite(cost_matrix)] <- Inf

g_full <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(cost_matrix, mode = "undirected", weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
igraph::V(g_full)$name <- sites_sf[[id_field_sites]]
g_mst <- igraph::mst(g_full, weights = igraph::E(g_full)$weight)

integration <- igraph::closeness(g_full, weights = igraph::E(g_full)$weight, normalized = TRUE)
choice      <- igraph::betweenness(g_full, weights = igraph::E(g_full)$weight, directed = FALSE, normalized = TRUE)

sites_sf$integration   <- as.numeric(integration)
sites_sf$choice        <- as.numeric(choice)
sites_sf$integration_z <- as.numeric(scale(sites_sf$integration))
sites_sf$choice_z      <- as.numeric(scale(sites_sf$choice))

if (!"Size_HA" %in% names(sites_sf)) {
  sites_sf$Size_HA <- as.numeric(sf::st_area(sites_sf)) / 10000
}

sites_sf$size_group <- cut(
  sites_sf$Size_HA,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 1, 5, Inf),
  labels = c("Small", "Medium", "Large"),
  right  = TRUE
)

size_fac <- droplevels(sites_sf$size_group)

valid_rows_int <- is.finite(sites_sf$integration) & !is.na(size_fac)
valid_rows_cho <- is.finite(sites_sf$choice)      & !is.na(size_fac)

grp_counts <- table(size_fac)
if (sum(grp_counts > 0) < 2) {
  warning("Not enough size groups with data to run Kruskal–Wallis/Dunn. Skipping non-parametric tests.")
} else {
  kw_int <- kruskal.test(integration ~ size_fac, data = sites_sf[valid_rows_int, ])
  kw_cho <- kruskal.test(choice      ~ size_fac, data = sites_sf[valid_rows_cho, ])
  
  if (!requireNamespace("dunn.test", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'dunn.test' is required for Dunn post hoc with Bonferroni. Please install it.")
  }
  
  dunn_int <- dunn.test::dunn.test(
    x = sites_sf$integration[valid_rows_int],
    g = size_fac[valid_rows_int],
    method = "bonferroni",
    kw = FALSE,
    list = TRUE
  )
  
  dunn_cho <- dunn.test::dunn.test(
    x = sites_sf$choice[valid_rows_cho],
    g = size_fac[valid_rows_cho],
    method = "bonferroni",
    kw = FALSE,
    list = TRUE
  )
  
  tidy_kw <- function(kw, varname) {
    data.frame(
      Variable = varname,
      H_stat   = round(as.numeric(kw$statistic), 3),
      df       = as.integer(kw$parameter),
      p_value  = signif(kw$p.value, 4),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  tidy_dunn <- function(d, varname) {
    data.frame(
      Variable     = varname,
      Comparison   = gsub(" - ", " vs ", d$comparisons, fixed = TRUE),
      Z_value      = round(d$Z, 3),
      p_raw        = signif(d$P, 4),
      p_bonferroni = signif(d$P.adjusted, 4),
      Significant  = ifelse(d$P.adjusted < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  tab_kw <- rbind(
    tidy_kw(kw_int, "Supra-local accessibility (integration)"),
    tidy_kw(kw_cho, "Path-through frequency (choice)")
  )
  
  tab_dunn <- rbind(
    tidy_dunn(dunn_int, "Supra-local accessibility (integration)"),
    tidy_dunn(dunn_cho, "Path-through frequency (choice)")
  )
  
  print(knitr::kable(tab_kw,  caption = "Space-syntax: Kruskal–Wallis omnibus tests by site size"))
  print(knitr::kable(tab_dunn, caption = "Space-syntax: Dunn post-hoc pairwise comparisons (Bonferroni)"))
}
```

```{r section_7_regression_models}
rds_files <- list.files(

)

stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) "" else if (p < 0.001) "***" else if (p < 0.01) "**" else if (p < 0.05) "*" else if (p < 0.1) "." else ""
}

to_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    x <- as.numeric(x)
    x[x == -999] <- NA_real_
    return(x)
  }
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("NA","Na","na",""," ","NULL","Null","null","-999")] <- NA_character_
  x <- gsub("([0-9]),([0-9])", "\\1.\\2", x)
  x <- gsub(",", "", x)
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  out[out == -999] <- NA_real_
  out
}

pick_col <- function(df_names, patterns) {
  for (pt in patterns) {
    hit <- grep(pt, df_names, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (length(hit) >= 1) return(hit[1])
  }
  NA_character_
}

safe_exp <- function(x) suppressWarnings(exp(x))

nb_summary_spss <- function(m) {
  ll_full <- tryCatch(as.numeric(logLik(m)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  m0 <- tryCatch(update(m, . ~ 1), error = function(e) NULL)
  ll_null <- tryCatch(as.numeric(logLik(m0)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  mcfadden <- if (is.finite(ll_full) && is.finite(ll_null)) 1 - (ll_full / ll_null) else NA_real_
  data.frame(
    N = tryCatch(stats::nobs(m), error = function(e) NA_integer_),
    Theta = tryCatch(if(inherits(m, "negbin")) as.numeric(m$theta) else NA_real_, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    AIC = tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_),
    BIC = tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_),
    logLik = ll_full,
    McFadden_R2 = mcfadden,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

confint_wald <- function(m, level = 0.95) {
  ci <- tryCatch(stats::confint.default(m, level = level), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(ci)) {
    cf <- coef(m)
    se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(m)))
    z <- stats::qnorm(1 - (1 - level) / 2)
    ci <- cbind(cf - z * se, cf + z * se)
    rownames(ci) <- names(cf)
    colnames(ci) <- c("2.5 %", "97.5 %")
  }
  ci
}

coef_table_gen <- function(m, outcome, model_label, predictor_label) {
  sm <- as.matrix(summary(m)$coefficients)
  ci <- confint_wald(m, level = 0.95)
  
  common <- intersect(rownames(sm), rownames(ci))
  sm <- sm[common, , drop = FALSE]
  ci <- ci[common, , drop = FALSE]
  
  df <- data.frame(
    Outcome = outcome,
    Model = model_label,
    Term = rownames(sm),
    Estimate = as.numeric(sm[, 1]),
    SE = as.numeric(sm[, 2]),
    z_val = as.numeric(sm[, 3]),
    p = as.numeric(sm[, 4]),
    CI_low = as.numeric(ci[, 1]),
    CI_high = as.numeric(ci[, 2]),
    Exp_Est = safe_exp(as.numeric(sm[, 1])),
    Exp_CI_low = safe_exp(as.numeric(ci[, 1])),
    Exp_CI_high = safe_exp(as.numeric(ci[, 2])),
    Sig = vapply(as.numeric(sm[, 4]), stars, character(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  df$Predictor <- predictor_label
  df
}

get_col_value <- function(df, row_i, candidates) {
  nm <- intersect(candidates, names(df))
  if (!length(nm)) return(NA_real_)
  val <- df[[nm[1]]][row_i]
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(val))
}

anova_lr_row <- function(m, outcome, model_label) {
  m0 <- tryCatch(update(m, . ~ 1), error = function(e) NULL)
  test_type <- if (inherits(m, "glm") && m$family$family == "quasibinomial") "F" else "Chisq"
  a <- tryCatch(stats::anova(m0, m, test = test_type), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (is.null(a)) {
    return(data.frame(Outcome = outcome, Model = model_label, Df = NA_real_, LR = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, Sig = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  a2 <- as.data.frame(a)
  if (nrow(a2) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(Outcome = outcome, Model = model_label, Df = NA_real_, LR = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, Sig = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  
  df_val <- get_col_value(a2, 2, c("Df", "df"))
  lr_val <- get_col_value(a2, 2, c("LR stat.", "LR stat", "Chisq", "Deviance", "F"))
  p_val <- get_col_value(a2, 2, c("Pr(>Chi)", "Pr(Chi)", "Pr(>Chisq)", "Pr(>F)"))
  
  data.frame(
    Outcome = outcome,
    Model = model_label,
    Df = df_val,
    LR = lr_val,
    p = p_val,
    Sig = stars(p_val),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

is_count_like <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(FALSE)
  all(x >= 0) && all(abs(x - round(x)) < 1e-8)
}

bootstrap_mean_ci <- function(x, R = 10000, conf = 0.95, seed = 2025236) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 3) stop("Not enough valid observations for bootstrap (n < 3).")
  set.seed(seed)
  boot_means <- replicate(R, mean(sample(x, size = n, replace = TRUE)))
  alpha <- 1 - conf
  ci <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(boot_means, probs = c(alpha/2, 1 - alpha/2), type = 7, names = FALSE))
  list(mean = mean(x), n = n, ci_low = ci[1], ci_high = ci[2])
}

format_bootstrap_line <- function(label, unit, res, digits = 1) {
  sprintf(
    "%s average %.1f %s in diameter (n = %s; 95%% CI = %.1f to %.1f %s).",
    label,
    round(res$mean, digits),
    unit,
    format(res$n, big.mark = ","),
    round(res$ci_low, digits),
    round(res$ci_high, digits),
    unit
  )
}

    m1 <- MASS::glm.nb(f1, data = d_terr)

  d_diam <- d0[is.finite(d0[[y]]) & is.finite(d0$Diamater_terraces), c(y, "Diamater_terraces"), drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d_diam) >= 10) {
    f2 <- stats::as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ Diamater_terraces"))
    m2 <- MASS::glm.nb(f2, data = d_diam)
    all_coef[[paste0(y, "_diam")]] <- coef_table_gen(m2, y, "NB_Diamater_only", "Diamater_terraces")

  struc_reg_join <- sf::st_join(structures_reg_sf, sites_reg_sf["site_uid"]) |> sf::st_drop_geometry()
  terr_reg_stats <- struc_reg_join |>
    dplyr::group_by(site_uid) |>
    dplyr::summarise(avg_terr_diam = mean(as.numeric(Diam_Terra), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  sites_reg_buffered <- sf::st_buffer(sites_reg_sf, dist = 30)
  cer_reg_join <- sf::st_join(cer_reg_sf, sites_reg_buffered["site_uid"], left = FALSE) |> sf::st_drop_geometry()
  func_reg_field <- if ("Function" %in% names(cer_reg_join)) "Function" else "Ceramic_ty"
  diam_reg_field <- if ("Rim_cm" %in% names(cer_reg_join)) "Rim_cm" else NA_character_

  cer_reg_df <- cer_reg_join |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Function = as.character(.data[[func_reg_field]]),
      Vessel_Diam = if (!is.na(diam_reg_field)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.data[[diam_reg_field]]))) else NA_real_
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Function = dplyr::na_if(Function, "-999"),
      Function = dplyr::na_if(Function, "NA"),
      Vessel_Diam = ifelse(Vessel_Diam == -999, NA_real_, Vessel_Diam)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(site_uid), !is.na(Function))

  cer_reg_stats <- cer_reg_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(site_uid) |>
    dplyr::summarise(avg_vessel_diam = mean(Vessel_Diam, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  rim_assoc_df <- sites_reg_sf |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    tibble::as_tibble() |>
    dplyr::select(site_uid, TERRACES) |>
    dplyr::left_join(terr_reg_stats, by = "site_uid") |>
    dplyr::left_join(cer_reg_stats, by = "site_uid") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      TERRACES = as.numeric(TERRACES),
      avg_terr_diam = as.numeric(avg_terr_diam),
      avg_vessel_diam = as.numeric(avg_vessel_diam)
    )

  rim_fit_terr <- stats::lm(avg_vessel_diam ~ TERRACES, data = rim_assoc_df[is.finite(rim_assoc_df$avg_vessel_diam) & is.finite(rim_assoc_df$TERRACES), ])
  rim_fit_diam <- stats::lm(avg_vessel_diam ~ avg_terr_diam, data = rim_assoc_df[is.finite(rim_assoc_df$avg_vessel_diam) & is.finite(rim_assoc_df$avg_terr_diam), ])

  rim_association_tbl <- data.frame(
    Outcome = "Average ceramic rim diameter",
    Predictor = c("Terraces", "Mean terrace diameter"),
    Estimate = c(unname(coef(summary(rim_fit_terr))[2,1]), unname(coef(summary(rim_fit_diam))[2,1])),
    p = c(unname(coef(summary(rim_fit_terr))[2,4]), unname(coef(summary(rim_fit_diam))[2,4])),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  rim_association_tbl$Estimate <- round(rim_association_tbl$Estimate, 6)
  rim_association_tbl$p <- ifelse(rim_association_tbl$p < 0.001, "< 0.001", format(round(rim_association_tbl$p, 6), nsmall = 6))
} else {
  rim_association_tbl <- data.frame(Outcome = character(), Predictor = character(), Estimate = numeric(), p = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

bootstrap_tbl <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("Residential terraces", "Ceramic rims"),
  Mean = c(round(terr_res$mean, 1), round(rim_res$mean, 1)),
  N = c(terr_res$n, rim_res$n),
  CI_low = c(round(terr_res$ci_low, 1), round(rim_res$ci_low, 1)),
  CI_high = c(round(terr_res$ci_high, 1), round(rim_res$ci_high, 1)),
  Unit = c("m", "cm"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(regression_manuscript_tbl, caption = "Regression models: manuscript-statistics summary")
knitr::kable(bootstrap_tbl, caption = "Bootstrap diameter estimates: manuscript-statistics summary")
knitr::kable(rim_association_tbl, caption = "Rim diameter associations: manuscript-statistics summary")
```

## 8. Network analysis
```{r section_8_network_analysis}
target_crs <- 32618

pick_existing_col <- function(df_names, candidates, regex_patterns = NULL, required = FALSE, label = "field") {
  hits <- intersect(candidates, df_names)
  if (length(hits) >= 1) return(hits[1])
  if (!is.null(regex_patterns)) {
    for (pt in regex_patterns) {
      hit <- grep(pt, df_names, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
      if (length(hit) >= 1) return(hit[1])
    }
  }
  if (required) {
    stop(paste0("Required ", label, " not found. Available fields are: ", paste(df_names, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  NA_character_
}

norm_minmax <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  if (length(x) == 0) return(numeric(0))
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  if (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) == min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) "" else if (p < 0.001) "***" else if (p < 0.01) "**" else if (p < 0.05) "*" else if (p < 0.1) "." else ""
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return(NA_character_)
  if (p < 0.001) return("< 0.001")
  sprintf("%.3f", p)
}

safe_shapiro <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  if (stats::sd(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(stats::shapiro.test(x)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

safe_levene <- function(df, y, g) {
  f <- stats::as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ ", g))
  out <- tryCatch(car::leveneTest(f, data = df), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(out)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(out$`Pr(>F)`[1])
}

standardize_size_group <- function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x)) x <- as.character(x)
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(
      factor(
        cut(
          x,
          breaks = c(-Inf, 0.5, 1, Inf),
          labels = c("Small sites", "Medium sites", "Large sites"),
          right = TRUE
        ),
        levels = c("Small sites", "Medium sites", "Large sites")
      )
    )
  }
  x_chr <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("^small$|^small site[s]?$|^small settlement[s]?$|^peque", x_chr) ~ "Small sites",
    grepl("^medium$|^medium site[s]?$|^medium settlement[s]?$|^med", x_chr) ~ "Medium sites",
    grepl("^large$|^large site[s]?$|^large settlement[s]?$|^big$|^grand|^grande", x_chr) ~ "Large sites",
    x_chr %in% c("1", "small", "s") ~ "Small sites",
    x_chr %in% c("2", "medium", "m") ~ "Medium sites",
    x_chr %in% c("3", "large", "l") ~ "Large sites",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
  factor(out, levels = c("Small sites", "Medium sites", "Large sites"))
}

desc_table <- function(df, y) {
  df |>
    dplyr::select(size_group, dplyr::all_of(y)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(size_group), is.finite(.data[[y]])) |>
    dplyr::group_by(size_group) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      metric = y,
      n = dplyr::n(),
      mean = mean(.data[[y]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = stats::sd(.data[[y]], na.rm = TRUE),
      median = stats::median(.data[[y]], na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr = stats::IQR(.data[[y]], na.rm = TRUE),
      min = min(.data[[y]], na.rm = TRUE),
      max = max(.data[[y]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

run_tests_one_metric <- function(df, y) {
  dd <- df |>
    dplyr::select(size_group, dplyr::all_of(y)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(size_group), is.finite(.data[[y]])) |>
    dplyr::mutate(size_group = droplevels(size_group))
  k <- dplyr::n_distinct(dd$size_group)
  if (k < 2) {
    return(list(
      assumptions = tibble::tibble(metric = y, group = NA_character_, n = NA_integer_, shapiro_p = NA_real_, levene_p = NA_real_),
      omnibus = tibble::tibble(metric = y, test = NA_character_, statistic = NA_real_, df = NA_character_, p_value = NA_real_, sig = NA_character_),
      posthoc = tibble::tibble(metric = y, contrast = NA_character_, p_adjusted = NA_real_, sig = NA_character_, method = NA_character_)
    ))
  }
  shapiro_tbl <- dd |>
    dplyr::group_by(size_group) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      shapiro_p = safe_shapiro(.data[[y]]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  lev_p <- safe_levene(dd, y = y, g = "size_group")
  assumptions <- shapiro_tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      metric = y,
      group = as.character(size_group),
      levene_p = lev_p
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(metric, group, n, shapiro_p, levene_p)
  normal_ok <- all((shapiro_tbl$n >= 3) & (!is.na(shapiro_tbl$shapiro_p)) & (shapiro_tbl$shapiro_p > 0.05))
  var_ok <- !is.na(lev_p) && lev_p > 0.05
  if (normal_ok && var_ok) {
    fit <- stats::aov(stats::as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ size_group")), data = dd)
    an <- summary(fit)[[1]]
    fval <- as.numeric(an$`F value`[1])
    df1 <- as.integer(an$Df[1])
    df2 <- as.integer(an$Df[2])
    p <- as.numeric(an$`Pr(>F)`[1])
    omnibus <- tibble::tibble(
      metric = y,
      test = "One-way ANOVA",
      statistic = fval,
      df = paste0(df1, ", ", df2),
      p_value = p,
      sig = stars(p)
    )
    tk <- stats::TukeyHSD(fit)[["size_group"]]
    posthoc <- tibble::as_tibble(tk, rownames = "contrast") |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        metric = y,
        contrast = gsub("-", " vs ", contrast, fixed = TRUE),
        p_adjusted = `p adj`,
        sig = stars(`p adj`),
        method = "Tukey HSD"
      )
  } else {
    kw <- stats::kruskal.test(stats::as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ size_group")), data = dd)
    omnibus <- tibble::tibble(
      metric = y,
      test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
      statistic = as.numeric(kw$statistic),
      df = as.character(as.integer(kw$parameter)),
      p_value = as.numeric(kw$p.value),
      sig = stars(as.numeric(kw$p.value))
    )
    pw <- stats::pairwise.wilcox.test(
      dd[[y]],
      dd$size_group,
      p.adjust.method = "holm",
      exact = FALSE
    )
    pmat <- pw$p.value
    if (is.null(pmat) || all(is.na(pmat))) {
      posthoc <- tibble::tibble(
        metric = y,
        contrast = NA_character_,
        p_adjusted = NA_real_,
        sig = NA_character_,
        method = NA_character_
      )
    } else {
      posthoc <- as.data.frame(as.table(pmat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      names(posthoc) <- c("group1", "group2", "p_adjusted")
      posthoc <- posthoc |>
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(p_adjusted)) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          metric = y,
          contrast = paste(group1, "vs", group2),
          sig = vapply(p_adjusted, stars, character(1)),
          method = "Pairwise Wilcoxon (Holm)"
        ) |>
        dplyr::select(metric, contrast, p_adjusted, sig, method) |>
        tibble::as_tibble()
    }
  }
  list(
    assumptions = assumptions,
    omnibus = omnibus,
    posthoc = posthoc
  )
}

run_spearman_architecture <- function(df, y, x = "avg_terr_diam") {
  dd <- df |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(x, y))) |>
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data[[x]]), is.finite(.data[[y]]))
  if (nrow(dd) < 3) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      metric = y,
      n = nrow(dd),
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      sig = NA_character_
    ))
  }
  if (stats::sd(dd[[x]]) == 0 || stats::sd(dd[[y]]) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      metric = y,
      n = nrow(dd),
      rho = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_,
      sig = NA_character_
    ))
  }
  ct <- suppressWarnings(
    stats::cor.test(
      x = dd[[x]],
      y = dd[[y]],
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )
  tibble::tibble(
    metric = y,
    n = nrow(dd),
    rho = unname(ct$estimate),
    p_value = unname(ct$p.value),
    sig = stars(unname(ct$p.value))
  )
}

cer_rds_path <- file.path(folder, "TAIRONA_CERAMICS.rds")
shp_sites_poly_f <- pick_file(c("TAIRONA_POLYGONS_SITES\\.shp$"), shps)

shp_survey_f <- pick_file(c("POLYGON_SURVEY_RIO_FRIO\\.shp$"), shps)

stopifnot(file.exists(cer_rds_path), !is.na(shp_sites_poly_f), !is.na(shp_structures_f))

sites_sf <- sf::st_read(shp_sites_poly_f, quiet = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_transform(target_crs) |>
  sf::st_make_valid()

if (!"site_uid" %in% names(sites_sf)) sites_sf$site_uid <- seq_len(nrow(sites_sf))
if (!"TERRACES" %in% names(sites_sf)) sites_sf$TERRACES <- NA_real_
if (!"Site_type" %in% names(sites_sf)) sites_sf$Site_type <- NA_character_
if (!"Site_size" %in% names(sites_sf)) sites_sf$Site_size <- NA_character_
if (!"Size_HA" %in% names(sites_sf)) {
  sites_sf$Size_HA <- as.numeric(sf::st_area(sites_sf)) / 10000
}

structures_sf <- sf::st_read(shp_structures_f, quiet = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_transform(target_crs)

cer_sf <- readRDS(cer_rds_path) |>
  sf::st_transform(target_crs)

survey_bg <- if (!is.na(shp_survey_f)) {
  sf::st_read(shp_survey_f, quiet = TRUE) |>
    sf::st_transform(target_crs) |>
    sf::st_make_valid() |>
    sf::st_union()
} else {
  sf::st_convex_hull(sf::st_union(sites_sf))
}
survey_bg <- sf::st_sf(geometry = survey_bg)

terr_diam_field <- pick_existing_col(
  names(structures_sf),
  candidates = c("Diam_Terra", "Diameter_terraces", "Diamater_terraces", "Terrace_diam", "Terrace_Diam"),
  regex_patterns = c("Diam.*Terra", "terr.*diam"),
  required = TRUE,
  label = "terrace diameter field"
)

func_field <- pick_existing_col(
  names(sf::st_drop_geometry(cer_sf)),
  candidates = c("Function", "Ceramic_ty"),
  regex_patterns = c("^Function$", "Ceramic"),
  required = TRUE,
  label = "ceramic function field"
)

diam_field <- pick_existing_col(
  names(sf::st_drop_geometry(cer_sf)),
  candidates = c("Rim_cm", "Rim", "Rim_Diam", "Rim_Diameter"),
  regex_patterns = c("^Rim", "diam"),
  required = FALSE,
  label = "rim diameter field"
)

if ("TERRACES" %in% names(sites_sf)) sites_sf$TERRACES[sites_sf$TERRACES == -999] <- NA
if (terr_diam_field %in% names(structures_sf)) structures_sf[[terr_diam_field]][structures_sf[[terr_diam_field]] == -999] <- NA

struc_join <- sf::st_join(structures_sf, sites_sf["site_uid"]) |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry()

terr_stats <- struc_join |>
  dplyr::group_by(site_uid) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    avg_terr_diam = mean(as.numeric(.data[[terr_diam_field]]), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_terraces_calc = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    avg_terr_diam = ifelse(is.nan(avg_terr_diam), NA_real_, avg_terr_diam)
  )

buffer_dist_m <- 30
sites_buffered <- sf::st_buffer(sites_sf, dist = buffer_dist_m)

cer_join <- sf::st_join(cer_sf, sites_buffered["site_uid"], left = FALSE)
cer_df <- cer_join |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry()

cer_df <- cer_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Function = as.character(.data[[func_field]]),
    Vessel_Diam = if (!is.na(diam_field)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.data[[diam_field]]))) else NA_real_
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Function = dplyr::na_if(Function, "-999"),
    Function = dplyr::na_if(Function, "NA"),
    Vessel_Diam = ifelse(Vessel_Diam == -999, NA_real_, Vessel_Diam)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(site_uid), !is.na(Function))

cer_stats <- cer_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(site_uid) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    avg_vessel_diam = mean(Vessel_Diam, na.rm = TRUE),
    func_richness = dplyr::n_distinct(Function),
    n_sherds = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    avg_vessel_diam = ifelse(is.nan(avg_vessel_diam), NA_real_, avg_vessel_diam)
  )

sites_attr_base <- sites_sf |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

if (!"TERRACES" %in% names(sites_attr_base)) sites_attr_base$TERRACES <- NA_real_
if (!"Site_type" %in% names(sites_attr_base)) sites_attr_base$Site_type <- NA_character_
if (!"Site_size" %in% names(sites_attr_base)) sites_attr_base$Site_size <- NA_character_
if (!"Size_HA" %in% names(sites_attr_base)) sites_attr_base$Size_HA <- NA_real_

sites_attr <- sites_attr_base |>
  dplyr::select(site_uid, TERRACES, Site_type, Site_size, Size_HA) |>
  dplyr::left_join(terr_stats, by = "site_uid") |>
  dplyr::left_join(cer_stats, by = "site_uid") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    TERRACES = tidyr::replace_na(as.numeric(TERRACES), 0),
    avg_terr_diam = tidyr::replace_na(as.numeric(avg_terr_diam), 0),
    avg_vessel_diam = tidyr::replace_na(as.numeric(avg_vessel_diam), 0),
    func_richness = tidyr::replace_na(as.numeric(func_richness), 0),
    n_sherds = tidyr::replace_na(as.numeric(n_sherds), 0),
    n_terraces_calc = tidyr::replace_na(as.numeric(n_terraces_calc), 0),
    norm_n_terr = norm_minmax(TERRACES),
    norm_diam_terr = norm_minmax(avg_terr_diam),
    norm_diam_vess = norm_minmax(avg_vessel_diam),
    norm_richness = norm_minmax(func_richness),
    norm_sherds = norm_minmax(n_sherds),
    complexity_index = (norm_n_terr + norm_diam_terr + norm_diam_vess + norm_richness + norm_sherds) / 5
  )

sites_net <- sites_attr |>
  dplyr::filter(n_sherds > 0) |>
  dplyr::arrange(site_uid)

stopifnot(nrow(sites_net) > 2)

X_comp <- sites_net |>
  dplyr::select(norm_n_terr, norm_diam_terr, norm_diam_vess, norm_richness, norm_sherds) |>
  as.matrix()
X_comp[is.na(X_comp)] <- 0

bc_dist <- function(x, y) {
  sx <- sum(x)
  sy <- sum(y)
  if ((sx + sy) == 0) return(1)
  1 - (2 * sum(pmin(x, y))) / (sx + sy)
}

n_sites <- nrow(X_comp)
D_matrix <- matrix(0, n_sites, n_sites)

for (i in seq_len(n_sites)) {
  for (j in i:n_sites) {
    dij <- bc_dist(X_comp[i, ], X_comp[j, ])
    D_matrix[i, j] <- dij
    D_matrix[j, i] <- dij
  }
}

diag(D_matrix) <- 0
D_matrix[!is.finite(D_matrix)] <- 1

S_matrix <- 1 - D_matrix
S_matrix[!is.finite(S_matrix)] <- 0
S_matrix <- pmin(pmax(S_matrix, 0), 1)

k_nn <- 3
edges_list <- vector("list", n_sites)

for (i in seq_len(n_sites)) {
  ord <- order(S_matrix[i, ], decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)
  ord <- ord[ord != i]
  targets <- head(ord, k_nn)
  targets <- targets[S_matrix[i, targets] > 0.0001]
  if (length(targets) > 0) {
    edges_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
      from = as.character(i),
      to = as.character(targets),
      weight = as.numeric(S_matrix[i, targets]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

edges_df_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(edges_list)
stopifnot(nrow(edges_df_raw) > 0)

edges_clean <- edges_df_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    from_num = as.numeric(from),
    to_num = as.numeric(to),
    key = paste(pmin(from_num, to_num), pmax(from_num, to_num), sep = "_")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(key) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    from = dplyr::first(from),
    to = dplyr::first(to),
    weight = max(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(from, to, weight)

vertices_df <- data.frame(
  name = as.character(seq_len(n_sites)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges_clean,
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = vertices_df
)

match_idx <- match(igraph::V(g)$name, vertices_df$name)
igraph::V(g)$site_uid <- sites_net$site_uid[match_idx]
igraph::V(g)$complexity <- as.numeric(sites_net$complexity_index[match_idx])

eps <- 1e-6
edge_sim <- pmax(as.numeric(igraph::E(g)$weight), eps)
edge_dist <- 1 / edge_sim

igraph::V(g)$betweenness <- igraph::betweenness(
  g,
  weights = edge_dist,
  normalized = TRUE
)

eig_raw <- igraph::eigen_centrality(
  g,
  weights = edge_sim,
  directed = FALSE,
  scale = TRUE
)$vector
igraph::V(g)$eigenvector <- as.numeric(eig_raw)

clo_raw <- suppressWarnings(
  igraph::closeness(g, weights = edge_dist, normalized = TRUE)
)
igraph::V(g)$closeness <- as.numeric(clo_raw)

igraph::V(g)$lcc <- igraph::transitivity(
  g,
  type = "localundirected",
  isolates = "zero"
)

net_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  site_uid = igraph::V(g)$site_uid,
  complexity = as.numeric(igraph::V(g)$complexity),
  betweenness = as.numeric(igraph::V(g)$betweenness),
  eigenvector = as.numeric(igraph::V(g)$eigenvector),
  closeness = as.numeric(igraph::V(g)$closeness),
  lcc = as.numeric(igraph::V(g)$lcc)
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    sites_net |>
      dplyr::select(
        site_uid,
        dplyr::any_of(c(
          "TERRACES", "Site_type", "Site_size", "Size_HA",
          "avg_terr_diam", "n_terraces_calc",
          "avg_vessel_diam", "func_richness",
          "n_sherds", "complexity_index"
        ))
      ),
    by = "site_uid"
  )

size_groups <- NULL

if ("Site_type" %in% names(sites_sf)) {
  size_groups <- sites_sf |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      site_uid,
      size_group = standardize_size_group(Site_type)
    )
}

if ((is.null(size_groups) || all(is.na(size_groups$size_group))) && "Site_size" %in% names(sites_sf)) {
  size_groups <- sites_sf |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      site_uid,
      size_group = standardize_size_group(Site_size)
    )
}

if (is.null(size_groups) || all(is.na(size_groups$size_group))) {
  size_groups <- sites_sf |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      site_uid,
      size_group = factor(
        cut(
          Size_HA,
          breaks = c(-Inf, 0.5, 1, Inf),
          labels = c("Small sites", "Medium sites", "Large sites"),
          right = TRUE
        ),
        levels = c("Small sites", "Medium sites", "Large sites")
      )
    )
}

dat_test <- net_summary |>
  dplyr::left_join(size_groups, by = "site_uid") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(size_group)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    size_group = factor(size_group, levels = c("Small sites", "Medium sites", "Large sites"))
  )

present_levels <- levels(dat_test$size_group)[levels(dat_test$size_group) %in% unique(as.character(dat_test$size_group))]
dat_test$size_group <- factor(dat_test$size_group, levels = present_levels)

metrics <- c("complexity", "betweenness", "eigenvector", "closeness", "lcc")

desc_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(metrics, function(m) desc_table(dat_test, m))) |>
  dplyr::arrange(metric, size_group)

res_list <- lapply(metrics, function(m) run_tests_one_metric(dat_test, m))

assumptions_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "assumptions")) |>
  dplyr::arrange(metric, group)

omnibus_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "omnibus")) |>
  dplyr::arrange(metric, p_value)

posthoc_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(res_list, `[[`, "posthoc")) |>
  dplyr::arrange(metric, p_adjusted)

knitr::kable(
  assumptions_tbl,
  digits = 6,
  caption = "Network analysis: normality and homogeneity checks by site-size class"
)

knitr::kable(
  desc_tbl,
  digits = 6,
  caption = "Network analysis: descriptive statistics by site-size class"
)

knitr::kable(
  omnibus_tbl,
  digits = 6,
  caption = "Network analysis: omnibus group-comparison tests"
)

knitr::kable(
  posthoc_tbl,
  digits = 6,
  caption = "Network analysis: Holm-adjusted post-hoc comparisons"
)

arch_metrics <- c("betweenness", "eigenvector", "closeness", "lcc")

arch_corr_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(arch_metrics, function(m) run_spearman_architecture(net_summary, m, x = "avg_terr_diam"))
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_value_label = vapply(p_value, format_p, character(1))
  )

knitr::kable(
  arch_corr_tbl |>
    dplyr::select(metric, n, rho, p_value, sig),
  digits = 6,
  caption = "Network analysis: Spearman correlations between mean terrace diameter and network metrics"
)

nodes_sf <- sf::st_point_on_surface(sites_sf) |>
  dplyr::select(site_uid) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(net_summary, by = "site_uid")

coords <- sf::st_coordinates(nodes_sf)

edge_lines_list <- lapply(seq_len(igraph::ecount(g)), function(i) {
  eidx <- igraph::ends(g, i, names = FALSE)
  sf::st_linestring(
    matrix(
      c(coords[eidx[1], ], coords[eidx[2], ]),
      ncol = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  )
})

edges_sf <- sf::st_sf(
  weight = edge_sim,
  geometry = sf::st_sfc(edge_lines_list, crs = sf::st_crs(nodes_sf))
)

edges_sf$weight_cat <- cut(
  edges_sf$weight,
  breaks = c(-0.1, 0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
  labels = c("0.00", "0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

edge_width_vals <- c(
  "0.00" = 0.2,
  "0.25" = 0.5,
  "0.50" = 0.8,
  "0.75" = 1.2,
  "1.00" = 1.8
)

north_style <- ggspatial::north_arrow_fancy_orienteering

base_map <- function(alpha_edges = 0.55, show_edge_legend = FALSE) {
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(data = survey_bg, fill = "grey90", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data = edges_sf,
      ggplot2::aes(linewidth = weight_cat),
      color = "grey40",
      alpha = alpha_edges
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_linewidth_manual(
      values = edge_width_vals,
      name = "Bray-Curtis\nSimilarity",
      guide = if (show_edge_legend) ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 2) else "none"
    ) +
    ggspatial::annotation_north_arrow(location = "tl", style = north_style) +
    ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.2) +
    ggplot2::theme_void() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, color = "grey30"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

pA <- base_map(show_edge_legend = TRUE) +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(
    data = nodes_sf,
    ggplot2::aes(size = complexity, fill = betweenness),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.25
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Ceramic Complexity\nIndex (0-1)",
    range = c(1.5, 7),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 1)
  ) +
  viridis::scale_fill_viridis(
    option = "viridis",
    name = "Betweenness",
    guide = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(order = 3)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "A. Betweenness",
    subtitle = "Fill: Betweenness | Size: Complexity"
  )

pB <- base_map() +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(
    data = nodes_sf,
    ggplot2::aes(size = complexity, fill = eigenvector),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.25
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Ceramic Complexity\nIndex (0-1)",
    range = c(1.5, 7),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 1)
  ) +
  viridis::scale_fill_viridis(
    option = "magma",
    name = "Eigenvector",
    guide = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(order = 3)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "B. Eigenvector",
    subtitle = "Fill: Eigenvector | Size: Complexity"
  )

pC <- base_map() +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(
    data = nodes_sf,
    ggplot2::aes(size = complexity, fill = closeness),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.25
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Ceramic Complexity\nIndex (0-1)",
    range = c(1.5, 7),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 1)
  ) +
  viridis::scale_fill_viridis(
    option = "plasma",
    name = "Closeness",
    guide = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(order = 3)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "C. Closeness",
    subtitle = "Fill: Closeness | Size: Complexity"
  )

pD <- base_map() +
  ggplot2::geom_sf(
    data = nodes_sf,
    ggplot2::aes(size = complexity, fill = lcc),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.25
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Ceramic Complexity\nIndex (0-1)",
    range = c(1.5, 7),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    guide = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 1)
  ) +
  viridis::scale_fill_viridis(
    option = "cividis",
    name = "Local Clustering",
    guide = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(order = 3)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "D. Local Clustering",
    subtitle = "Fill: Local Clustering | Size: Complexity"
  )

p_all <- (pA | pB) / (pC | pD) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "keep")

print(p_all)
```
